essence: Twenty-one recitations bring about the destruction of black magic.
Recitations counted as four-fours and zero-fives remove eye disease and all poison.
One should recite the mantra one hundred and eight times for those killed by fire.
This practice brings about the accomplishment of whatever is declared for Vedic purposes.
The mantra block endowed with sixty and a dot is declared for followers of the right-hand path.
